notes.title: Massive update 5/26/2024
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720171/9859bb3f4cf40e93b8fcac6fee2b73bc7d035fee.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43720171/2d864aeeb85e4f774b92011024a3d5d9dde4f038.png[/img][/url]

Bug Fixes:

Fixed issue causing players to experience crashes during game-play.
Resolved the bug where the inventory items were duplicating.
Addressed the problem with NPCs disappearing in certain areas.
Fixed the issue where the sound effects were not playing correctly on certain devices.
Improvements:

Optimized game performance for smoother gameplay on all devices.
Enhanced the user interface for better navigation and usability.
Improved the in-game tutorial to provide clearer instructions for new players.

Steam Achievements:
Fixed the bug preventing players from unlocking the "any" achievement.
Resolved the issue with achievements not registering correctly in the Steam system.
Added new achievements for completing specific in-game challenges or reaching milestones.
Updated descriptions for existing achievements to provide more clarity on how to unlock them.
General:

Implemented various backend improvements to enhance overall game stability.
Updated localization for better language support.
Fixed minor text errors and typos in dialogues and menus.
Implemented player feedback suggestions for a more enjoyable gaming experience.

notes.title: Crash update 3/14/23
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am truly sorry about the launch of Last Stop no one is more disappointed then I am. These things happen and for that im sorry. All should be fixed and people have reported it working on the Steam Deck. we went through the code and removed a lot of bugs this morning as well as cleaned up project files and notest the game was running smother. however we did get reports that the option menu is now acting up and we will be working hard to fix that up as well. please stay tuned.

The Tainted Games Team.

notes.title: Crash update Steam Deck
notes.notes:
What a launch day huh, people have been reporting crashes that hopefully now have been fixed with the new update. I guess that's why day one patches exist. Sorry to everyone trying to play. Please try to update with the patch or uninstall the game completely then reinstall it.

to get the game running on the Deck please use Proton HotfIx in the compatibility settings.

The Tainted Games Team.

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatible Pole
notes.notes: Steam Deck Compatible pole. It takes time to get the little green check mark, we've built this game to run on the Steam Deck and need your help to get it verified as 100% compatible. All you have to do is play the game on the Deck and when it asks you if it play great go ahead and hit the YES button.
